cards.en: I am from Germany.
cards.note: ser for where you are from

cards.en: She is at the airport.
cards.note: estar for location

cards.en: The coffee is very hot.
cards.note: estar for a temporary state

cards.en: My sister is a doctor.
cards.note: ser for a profession

cards.en: We are tired today.
cards.note: estar for how you feel

cards.en: The soup tastes good.
cards.note: estar rico means it tastes good right now

cards.en: They are my neighbours.
cards.note: ser for identity

cards.en: Where is the toilet?
cards.note: estar for a fixed location

cards.en: The ticket is cheap.
cards.note: ser for a lasting quality

cards.en: The shop is closed.
cards.note: estar with abierto and cerrado

cards.en: Today is Monday.
cards.note: ser for days and dates

cards.es: Yo estoy perdido en el centro.
cards.en: I am lost in the town centre.
cards.note: estar for the situation you are in

cards.es: Hay un restaurante cerca de aquí.
cards.en: There is a restaurant near here.
cards.note: hay introduces something that exists

cards.es: El hotel está en la playa.
cards.en: The hotel is on the beach.
cards.note: a known thing takes estar, not hay

cards.en: Is there milk in the fridge?
cards.note: hay for an unknown quantity

cards.en: There are no free seats.
cards.note: hay never changes for the plural

cards.es: Yo estudio español todos los días.
cards.en: I study Spanish every day.
cards.note: regular -ar verb, the yo form ends in -o

cards.en: You drink a lot of coffee.
cards.note: regular -er verb, the tú form ends in -es

cards.en: She lives in Madrid.
cards.note: regular -ir verb, the ella form ends in -e

cards.en: We work in an office.
cards.note: the nosotros form of -ar verbs ends in -amos

cards.en: You all read the menu.
cards.note: the vosotros form of -er verbs ends in -éis

cards.en: They open the door.
cards.note: the ellos form of -ir verbs ends in -en

cards.en: I have a question.
cards.note: tener is irregular in the yo form

cards.en: You go to the market.
cards.note: ir goes voy, vas, va, vamos, vais, van

cards.es: Nosotros vamos al cine el sábado.
cards.en: We are going to the cinema on Saturday.
cards.note: ir also carries the near future

cards.en: She cannot speak German.
cards.note: poder changes o to ue in the stem

cards.es: Yo quiero un café, por favor.
cards.en: I would like a coffee, please.
cards.note: querer changes e to ie in the singular

cards.en: What do you do at weekends?
cards.note: hacer gives hago in the yo form only

cards.en: I know it is late.
cards.note: saber for facts, and the yo form is just sé

cards.text: ___ a mi vecino desde hace años.
cards.es: Conozco a mi vecino desde hace años.
cards.en: I have known my neighbour for years.
cards.note: conocer for people and places

cards.text: A mí me ___ el vino tinto.
cards.es: A mí me gusta el vino tinto.
cards.en: I like red wine.
cards.note: one thing liked, so gusta stays singular

cards.en: I like quiet beaches.
cards.note: a plural thing liked takes gustan

cards.en: Do you like travelling by train?
cards.note: the person who likes takes me, te, le, nos, os, les

cards.text: A ella no le ___ el pescado.
cards.es: A ella no le gusta el pescado.
cards.en: She does not like fish.
cards.note: gustar agrees with the thing, not the person

cards.en: We like this village a lot.
cards.note: nos for we, and the verb still follows the thing

cards.en: My head hurts.
cards.note: doler works exactly like gustar

cards.es: Yo me levanto a las siete.
cards.en: I get up at seven.
cards.note: reflexive verbs take me in the yo form

cards.es: Ella se ducha por la mañana.
cards.en: She showers in the morning.
cards.note: se for él, ella and ellos

cards.en: What is your name?
cards.note: llamarse is reflexive, literally you call yourself

cards.en: We get dressed quickly.
cards.note: nos for the nosotros form

cards.en: I am going to go to bed early.
cards.note: after an infinitive the pronoun hooks onto the end

cards.es: Ellos se sientan en el sofá.
cards.en: They sit down on the sofa.
cards.note: sentarse takes se for ellos

cards.en: This present is for you.
cards.note: para for the recipient

cards.en: Thank you for your help.
cards.note: gracias por is fixed

cards.en: We leave for Madrid tomorrow.
cards.note: para for the destination

cards.en: We walk through the park.
cards.note: por for movement through a place

cards.text: Estudio español ___ hablar con mis amigos.
cards.es: Estudio español para hablar con mis amigos.
cards.en: I study Spanish in order to talk to my friends.
cards.note: para plus infinitive gives the purpose

cards.es: Pagué veinte euros por el billete.
cards.en: I paid twenty euros for the ticket.
cards.note: por for an exchange

cards.es: El tren sale por la mañana.
cards.en: The train leaves in the morning.
cards.note: por la mañana, por la tarde, por la noche

cards.es: La reserva es para dos personas.
cards.en: The booking is for two people.
cards.note: para for who something is meant for

cards.en: Yesterday I ate a paella.
cards.note: preterite for a finished action

cards.text: Ella ___ al hotel a las nueve.
cards.es: Ella llegó al hotel a las nueve.
cards.en: She arrived at the hotel at nine.
cards.note: the él and ella preterite of -ar verbs ends in -ó

cards.text: Nosotros ___ el tren de las ocho.
cards.es: Nosotros tomamos el tren de las ocho.
cards.en: We took the eight o'clock train.
cards.note: for -ar verbs the nosotros preterite looks like the present

cards.en: Did you write the message?
cards.note: the tú preterite of -ir verbs ends in -iste

cards.es: Ellos estuvieron en Barcelona tres días.
cards.en: They were in Barcelona for three days.
cards.note: estar has the irregular preterite stem estuv-

cards.text: Yo ___ al médico la semana pasada.
cards.es: Yo fui al médico la semana pasada.
cards.en: I went to the doctor last week.
cards.note: ir and ser share the preterite fui, fuiste, fue

cards.en: He made a lot of noise last night.
cards.note: hacer gives hice and hizo in the preterite

cards.en: I did not have time for breakfast.
cards.note: tener has the irregular preterite stem tuv-

cards.es: Ellos pagaron el vuelo por internet.
cards.en: They paid for the flight online.
cards.note: the ellos preterite of -ar verbs ends in -aron

cards.text: El avión ___ con dos horas de retraso.
cards.es: El avión salió con dos horas de retraso.
cards.en: The plane left two hours late.
cards.note: the él preterite of -ir verbs ends in -ió

cards.text: Cuando era niño, ___ mucho en la playa.
cards.es: Cuando era niño, jugaba mucho en la playa.
cards.en: When I was a child I used to play on the beach a lot.
cards.note: imperfect for what used to happen

cards.es: Antes ella trabajaba en un restaurante.
cards.en: She used to work in a restaurant.
cards.note: imperfect for a habit in the past

cards.en: It was ten o'clock when we arrived.
cards.note: imperfect for the time and the background

cards.text: Mientras yo cocinaba, ella ___ un libro.
cards.es: Mientras yo cocinaba, ella leía un libro.
cards.en: While I was cooking she was reading a book.
cards.note: two things going on at once, so both imperfect

cards.text: De niños ___ a España cada verano.
cards.es: De niños íbamos a España cada verano.
cards.en: As children we went to Spain every summer.
cards.note: ir has the imperfect iba, ibas, iba, íbamos

cards.text: Hacía frío y no ___ nadie en la calle.
cards.es: Hacía frío y no había nadie en la calle.
cards.en: It was cold and there was nobody in the street.
cards.note: había is the imperfect of hay

cards.en: I live in Berlin.
cards.note: en for being somewhere

cards.en: We are going to the beach.
cards.note: a for movement towards

cards.es: Es el coche de mi hermano.
cards.en: It is my brother's car.
cards.note: de shows possession

cards.es: Hablo con mi jefe esta tarde.
cards.en: I am speaking with my boss this afternoon.
cards.note: hablar con someone

cards.es: El vaso está en la mesa.
cards.en: The glass is on the table.
cards.note: en covers both in and on

cards.en: I am coming from work.
cards.note: de plus el contracts to del

cards.en: I am going to the airport by taxi.
cards.note: a plus el contracts to al

cards.en: I am waiting for my friend.
cards.note: a person as object takes the a

cards.en: The house is very small.
cards.note: casa is feminine

cards.en: The problem is the delay.
cards.note: problema ends in -a but is masculine

cards.en: The keys are lost.
cards.note: adjectives copy gender and number

cards.en: I have two younger sisters.
cards.note: adjectives ending in a consonant just add -es

cards.en: It is a very quiet city.
cards.note: ciudad is feminine

cards.en: The water is cold.
cards.note: agua takes el but stays feminine, so fría

cards.en: I have to check in the luggage.
cards.note: tener que is always followed by the infinitive

cards.en: I have just arrived.
cards.note: acabar de plus infinitive means to have just done something

cards.es: Estoy leyendo un libro en español.
cards.en: I am reading a book in Spanish.
cards.note: estar plus -ando or -iendo for right now

cards.en: I am going to study tonight.
cards.note: ir a plus infinitive is the everyday future

cards.es: No hay nada en la nevera.
cards.en: There is nothing in the fridge.
cards.note: double negative is normal in Spanish

cards.en: I also want to go to the museum.
cards.note: también adds, tampoco adds to a negative

cards.en: I have not had breakfast yet.
cards.note: todavía no means not yet

cards.en: I have already seen that film.
cards.note: ya means already

cards.text: Este café es ___ caro que el otro.
cards.es: Este café es más caro que el otro.
cards.en: This coffee is more expensive than the other one.
cards.note: más plus adjective plus que for comparisons

cards.text: Mi hermano es ___ alto como yo.
cards.es: Mi hermano es tan alto como yo.
cards.en: My brother is as tall as I am.
cards.note: tan plus adjective plus como for as ... as
